$:set -euo pipefail
cat AGENTS.md >/dev/null
if test -f README.md; then cat README.md >/dev/null; fi
gh api repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/issues/3 --jq .body >/dev/null
printf 'HEAD '; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'TARGET '; if test -e .devcontainer/devcontainer.json; then echo PRESENT; else echo ABSENT; fi
printf 'METADATA '; if test -e config/file-metadata.json; then echo PRESENT; else echo ABSENT; fi
printf 'TRACKED '; git ls-files -- .devcontainer/devcontainer.json
printf 'LAST TARGET COMMITS\n'; git log -4 --format='%h %s' -- .devcontainer/devcontainer.json
printf 'STATUS\n'; git status --short
